messages:
kevin-choi: Heads up — planning the next release train Tue 2026-03-24 10:00 PST. Need deploy owners for these services and smoke-check volunteers. No planned downtime. /cc @maria-gonzalez @samir

maria-gonzalez: I can own service-a (backend). Will run smoke checks for A + integration smoke. Confirming timezone — 10:00 PST works for me.

samir: I'll take service-b (frontend) and the config rollout. Any DB migrations? If so we should schedule a short migration window.

jen: no DB migrations for this train. small schema tweak is behind a feature flag. I can run smoke checks for service-b + do post-deploy perf sanity.

tara-eng: I'll be on-call that week, can own rollback if we need it. Ping me in thread.

deploy-bot: Slot reserved: Tue 10:00 PST. Calendar invite sent to channel.

kevin-choi: Proposed cadence: service-a deploy 10:00-10:15, service-b deploy 10:15-10:30, canary/monitoring 10:30-10:45. Staggered rollouts to limit blast radius. Agree?

maria-gonzalez: Works for me. I'll do canary at 10:00 -> 50% for 5 min then 100% if green.

samir: Works. I'll start frontend canary at 10:15 with gradual ramp to 50% then hold for 10m.

jen: Smoke checklist (run after each deploy):
```
1) curl /health -> 200
2) ./scripts/smoke.sh --service <svc>
3) check errors in logs: errors < 1%
4) run critical-path e2e
```
I'll post the smoke results in this thread.

kevin-choi: Rollback plan if errors:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/service-a -n prod || ./ops/rollback-service-a.sh
```
Whoever triggers rollback, ping @tara-eng and tag #oncall. Also set feature-flag back to previous state if needed.

maria-gonzalez: Noted. I'll monitor DB connection pools and JVM heap during canary.

samir: I'll collect canary metrics and post a short summary: latency, 5xx rate, CPU. Trigger rollback if latency > 200ms for 3 consecutive samples or 5xx > 1%.

jen: Can someone own post-deploy alert triage for the first 30m? @samir?

samir: I can do the first 15m, then hand off to @tara-eng for ongoing triage.

kevin-choi: Thanks — I'll update the release train doc and attach the deploy checklist: https://redwood.internal/docs/release-train-checklist

maria-gonzalez: Reminder: enable feature-flag service-a:ff_newcache=true during canary only.

kevin-choi: Perfect. I'll add these owners to the calendar invite and copy the rollback commands into the ticket. See you Tue. :thumbsup:
